::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
Attention is $O(n^2)$ in sequence length. Two attack surfaces: **systems**
(FlashAttention, Dao 2022 — IO-aware exact attention) and **algorithmic**
(sparse: Longformer/BigBird; linear: Performer/Linformer — approximate the
softmax to drop the quadratic term).
:::

**Depends on:** [Self-Attention & Multi-Head Attention](../02_transformer/01_self_attention.qmd)

## The mechanism

### FlashAttention — IO-aware exact attention

### Sparse attention — restrict the attention pattern (Longformer, BigBird)

### Linear attention — approximate the softmax (Performer, Linformer)
